violations.text: The presence of mice is not controlled as evidenced by droppings throughout the dry storage area, and parts of the kitchen. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Establishment is to clean any and all droppings using appropriate means of sanitization to monitor for new activity. Per PIC, "bidding" for a new pest control service will be taken place on 8/25. Establishment is to contact inspector with a pest control report once an evaluation has taken place. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

The floor in the dry storage area, and under equipment in kitchen has an accumulation of soil residue, droppings, and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Establishment must apply for a RICFSM with RIDOH. Application was printed at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 08/10/2026

Pizza was observed held at 115 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Pizza was reheated to above 165 DF, and hot-holding unit was turned up at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

Ham, turkey, tomatoes, and tuna were observed held between 45-55 degrees Fahrenheit in the deli service unit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Per PIC, all food was recently placed into unit 45 minutes prior to inspection. All food was moved to freezer to rapidly cool at the time of inspection. Establishment is not to store any TCS foods in unit, if unit is not able to hold an internal food temperature of 41 DF or less. Establishment is to monitor all food temperatures in the deli service unit. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Per interview of PIC, pasta was being placed hot in plastic bags, and in containers greater than four inches deep. All pasta was removed from potion bags and placed on to sheet pans at the time of inspection. Proper cooling methods reviewed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

The presence of mice is not controlled as evidenced by droppings throughout the dry storage area, and parts of the kitchen. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Establishment is to clean any and all droppings using appropriate means of sanitization. Establishment is to continue to work with pest control, increase pest control as frequently as needed, and is to have a pest control report available for inspector at the time of the next inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

Plastic straws were observed in contact with rodent droppings in the dry storage area. Single use items, food, and equipment must be stored in a manner to prevent contamination from rodents. Items were voluntarily disposed by person in charge. SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be stored in the original protective PACKAGE or stored by using other means that afford protection from contamination until used. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026
The 3 door reach-in refrigeration unit was observed non-operational and in poor repair. Equipment must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

The floor in the dry storage area, and under equipment in kitchen has an accumulation of soil residue, droppings, and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener, slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. -Staff washed, rinsed, and sanitized the can opener and slicer during this inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/11/2025

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Chicken stock, vegetable stock, and potato soup were placed hot in the walk-in cooler covered with a plastic wrap and a lid over it. -Chicken stock observed at 49 degrees Fahrenheit, vegetable stock observed at 79 degrees Fahrenheit, and potato soup observed at 57 degrees Fahrenheit. -Per PIC, vegetable soup was cooled down 1 hour prior to this inspection. Proper cooling methods reviewed. -Staff removed the lid and plastic wrap from the containers to allow for rapid cooling in the walk-in cooler. The vegetable soup was moved to the walk-in freezer to allow for rapid cooling. -Vegetable soup was observed at 64 degrees Fahrenheit 30 minutes after the initial observation. -Establishment shall keep a cooling log for foods in the cooling process. -Cooling log must be maintained for 1 week and emailed to inspector. -Cooling log provided to establishment at the time of this inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/11/2025

Soups in the self-service area are lacking a list of ingredients for the foods. Foods in the self-service area must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, and major food allergen. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 02/11/2025

The presence of droppings is not controlled as evidenced by droppings observed underneath/behind kitchen equipment and underneath shelving in the dry storage area. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. -Establishment must sweep all areas observed with droppings and monitor for activity. If droppings observed after cleaning, establishment must get pest control to do a full assessment/evaluation of the facility. New Violation. Correct By: 02/11/2025
Some light bulbs in the kitchen area were not in good repair. Bulbs shall be replaced. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 02/18/2025
The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine at the kitchen. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 02/11/2025

The coating of the ceiling in the storage area is in poor repair. Coating observed peeling at the time of this inspection. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 03/18/2025

Working containers of various dry ingredients are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 11/21/2023

The following equipment was observed in poor repair: -The hot hold steam units were being used as ice baths for cold holding foods. -All cold drawer units were observed non functional. -The 3 door reach-in in the downstairs kitchen was observed non functional. Equipment shall be maintained in good repair. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/21/2023
The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine. New Violation. Correct By: 11/21/2023
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the sanitizing solution for the 3-bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 11/21/2023

The pre-flush spray hose at the 3-bay sink is hanging below the flood rim. A plumbing system shall be installed to prevent backflow of a liquid or gas contaminant into the water supply by providing an air gap or installing an approved backflow prevention device. New Violation. Correct By: 12/05/2023
The floors in the dry storage area has an accumulation of rodent droppings. New Violation. Correct By: 11/21/2023
